objectives:
This course will be divided into two parts:
(1)	The review of corporate finance
(2)	Selected papers presentation
content:
The review of corporate finance
We will review the fundamental theory of corporate finance, which includes Basic Quantitative Analysis, risk profile, present and future value, NPV (IRR), risk and return, portfolio theory, CAPM, and bond pricing. So, I will adopt the slides to do the teaching and provide some practical problems (for the exam)

Selected papers presentation
Presentation and Written Report (Selected papers presentation)
Final report
